composition.note: The source cites Brahms’s 1897 death and the work’s nineteenth-century publication. This is the composition rights statement; it is not being used to clear the modern sound recording or an unidentified modern edition.

recording.value: Commons explicitly states that Musopen released this sound recording into the public domain worldwide, with an unrestricted-use fallback where dedication is not legally possible.
recording.note: The file’s Licensing section separates “Recording” from “Musical composition”. The recording-specific Musopen release is the eligibility basis, not the composition’s age. The upstream collection also links to the Public Domain Mark; no non-commercial restriction is stated there. This reports the source’s express release and does not independently audit contractual ownership.
